candidate.rationale: Restore slice-bounds handling per evidence requirements: reject an interior start that splits a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward before the pair instead of producing a split read; validate progress and empty-slice-at-EOF as before.

Replace JSON.stringify string comparison with isDeepStrictEqual so parsed JSON is compared structurally (object member order insignificant, array order/types/missing/extra significant), while preserving response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match, and answer_mismatch behavior.

Repair the retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and require each tool result to positionally match the assistant call at the same index (message.tool_call_id === ids[index]) instead of mere membership. Masking of old content and all other behavior preserved.

Repair controlled retention-long-window mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (new Set(ids).size === ids.length) and require each tool result to pair positionally with its assistant call (message.tool_call_id === ids[index]) instead of mere membership. Masking behavior, export, and unrelated behavior are unchanged.

Repair retention-tool-pair validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per inspected requirements. Recent-tail masking behavior unchanged.

Restore the controlled retention-tool-pairs validation: tool call IDs must be unique within each exchange, and each tool result must match the assistant call at the same positional index (not merely be a member of the ID set). All other behavior, including masking of old content and preservation of the recent tail, is unchanged.

Replace JSON.stringify comparison with structural isDeepStrictEqual so nested values compare correctly regardless of object member order; keep response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match, and answer_mismatch behavior unchanged.
Repair slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior surrogate-pair start and move an interior end backward before the pair, preserving validation, return fields, and the empty-at-EOF allowance.
Restores surrogate-pair handling: reject a start offset that would split a pair, and move an interior end backward to the pair boundary before validating progress.

Replace order-sensitive JSON.stringify comparison with isDeepStrictEqual structural equality, so reordered object keys match while array order, types, and missing/extra members stay significant; preserve response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match, and answer_mismatch behavior and the export.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (positional ID check) instead of membership-only, per evidence/cases.json requirements and example interpretations. Masking window and all other behavior preserved.
